title: The Group Chat of Cedar Falls
author: Sebastian Ishikawa
blurb: Mirabel Thornbury, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
